properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Alex's idea, from the Opportunities section of his 2026-08-14 session (docs/feedback/2026-08-14-alex-grok-session.md), in his words: "Add `change_type` for as-built defects (`defect_fix` / `as_built_fix`), or officially alias `test_failure_fix`."

DELIBERATELY SEPARATE FROM `fact:defect-change-event-has-no-type-for-a-field-reported-defect`, which the near-duplicate guard correctly surfaced: that node MEASURES the problem and counts its five occurrences; this one holds the UNMADE CHOICE about the shape of the fix. Merging them would put an open question inside a settled measurement, and the fact would then read as though it had proposed its own answer.

WHY IT IS WORTH MORE THAN ITS ONE LINE: the evidence is now five forced choices, not one — two maintainer sessions, one fleet, Alex, and the very edit that recorded his corroboration, each picking a different least-wrong value.

THE OPTIONS:

(a) ADD `defect_fix` (or `field_report_fix`) — exactly what he proposed. CHEAP: enum values are not counted by the version stamp, so it is not a schema break. COUNTER, and the reason this is a question rather than a task: the five forced choices needed at least THREE different missing meanings — a defect fix, "an open question was settled" (`chg:arrival-delta-decided`), and "the design's knowledge moved while the thing did not". One value fixes the loudest instance and leaves the pattern.

(b) OFFICIALLY ALIAS `test_failure_fix` — his cheaper alternative: document that this is the bucket. CHEAPEST, no schema move. COUNTER: it makes a structured field permanently mean something other than its name, and the project rejected that reasoning once already — `baseline_established` exists precisely because forcing a record-only change through a code category "writes a fiction into the ledger that exists to prevent fiction".

(c) SPLIT THE AXIS — carry a `subject: system | record` alongside a narrower type. MOST HONEST: `baseline_established`'s own doc comment already names the axis — "every other variant answers why the thing changed; this one says the thing did not change and only the design's knowledge of it did" — then leaves it with one member, reserved. COUNTER: a real schema property on a type with a lot of history, and every existing ChangeEvent would carry an unstated subject, which is the "absent means nobody said" problem again.

(d) A STRUCTURED `reported_by` / `found_by` PROPERTY — the other half of Alex's own suggestion. Keeps how-it-was-found structured rather than narrated. COUNTER: orthogonal to the gap; it records provenance of the discovery, not the kind of the change, so (a) or (c) would still be owed.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the three missing meanings are all of them, or only the three that happen to have been hit.
properties.name: IDEA — `change_type` has no value for an as-built defect. Add one, alias an existing one, or split the axis it is actually conflating?
properties.rationale: Recorded via the brainstorm skill: one Decision per open question, at `proposed`, options with their counters beside them, nothing promoted. Started as a new node rather than merged into the measuring fact after the near-duplicate guard named it — a measurement and an unmade choice are different acts, and folding the second into the first would make the fact appear to answer itself.
